user.title: Choose a location
user.description: Select a Korean forecast location. Korea Weather Fusion will resolve and validate the KMA, Naver, and Weatheri settings automatically.

air_station.title: Choose an air-quality station
air_station.description: Location: {location}. Resolved KMA area: {kma_location}. Choose the Weatheri monitoring station to validate all three sources.

advanced.title: Advanced manual setup
advanced.description: Enter every source selector manually. Use this only for unsupported locations or troubleshooting.

abort.already_configured: Korea Weather Fusion is already configured.
abort.unknown: The setup flow could not be resumed. Start again.

error.invalid_weatheri_air_data: Weatheri did not return valid data for the selected station.
